{
  "CorrectedAdvert": {
    "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>
    <SOURCE>Dem Publico dienet zur Nachricht, dass das gelehrte und weitbekannte Kgl. Tschudi-Land-Ammann in Glarus...</SOURCE>
    <BIBLIOGRAPHY>
        <TITLE>Schweitzer-Chronik</TITLE>
        <DESCRIPTION>Eine hochgeschätzte, in mehreren Folianten verfasste Schrift, wegen ihrer hervorragenden Qualität nur wenige Bibliotheken mit großem Aufwand abgeschrieben worden und als seltenes Werk zur Geschichte der Eidgenossenschaft und der umliegenden Länder sehr nützliches Werk erhalten worden.</DESCRIPTION>
        <PUBLICATION>
            <TITLE>Das Werk</TITLE>
            <VOLUMES>
                <VOLUME>2. Theilen</VOLUME>
                <FORMAT>Folio</FORMAT>
            </VOLUMES>
            <PRICING>
                <TERM>Erster Juli 1734</TERM>
                <PAYMENT_SCHEDULE>
                    <TERM_TYPE>Erster Theil</TERM_TYPE>
                    <FORMAT>Papier</FORMAT>
                    <PRICE>4. fl.</PRICE>
                    <REDEEM_TERM>Nach Auslieferung</REDEEM_TERM>
                    <REDEEM_PRICE>4. fl.</REDEEM_PRICE>
                    <TOTAL_PRICE>8. fl.</TOTAL_PRICE>
                </PAYMENT_SCHEDULE>
                <TERM_TYPE>Zweiter Theil</TERM_TYPE>
                <FORMAT>Papier</FORMAT>
                <PRICE>3. fl.</PRICE>
                <REDEEM_TERM>Nach Auslieferung</REDEEM_TERM>
                <REDEEM_PRICE>3. fl.</REDEEM_PRICE>
                <TOTAL_PRICE>6. fl.</TOTAL_PRICE>
                <ALTERNATIVE_TERM>
                    <TERM_TYPE>Erster Theil</TERM_TYPE>
                    <PRICE>12. fl.</PRICE>
                    <TERM_TYPE>Zweiter Theil</TERM_TYPE>
                    <PRICE>9. fl.</PRICE>
                    <NOTICE>Wird nicht mehr gegeben</NOTICE>
                </ALTERNATIVE_TERM>
            </PRICING>
            <AUTHOR_PROJECT>
                <NAME>Hanß Jacob Bischoff</NAME>
                <LOCATION>Buchhändler in Basel</LOCATION>
                <LOCATIONS>Andere Orte der Eidgenossenschaft</LOCATIONS>
            </AUTHOR_PROJECT>
        </PUBLICATION>
    </BIBLIOGRAPHY>
    <PUBLISHING_INFO>
        <PURPOSE>Zum gemeinen Besten per Subscription gedruckt</PURPOSE>
        <PROJECT_LOCATION>Basel</PROJECT_LOCATION>
    </PUBLISHING_INFO>
</ITEM>",
    "number_of_corrections": 15,
    "explanation": {
        "1. Structural Fixes": [
            "Added proper XML namespace and root structure with `<SOURCE>`, `<BIBLIOGRAPHY>`, `<PUBLICATION>`, `<PRICING>`, `<PAYMENT_SCHEDULE>`, `<TERM_TYPE>`, `<ALTERNATIVE_TERM>`, `<AUTHOR_PROJECT>`, and `<PUBLISHING_INFO>` tags for logical organization.",
            "Fixed malformed and redundant `<BIBL>` tags by restructuring into `<BIBLIOGRAPHY>` and `<DESCRIPTION>`."
        ],
        "2. Textual Corrections": [
            "Fixed Unicode characters (e.g., `` → `ß`, `` → `ch`, `` → `ü`, `` → `ß` for `ß` in German).",
            "Corrected grammatical and syntactical errors in the text (e.g., 'bi' → 'nach Auslieferung', 'astimirt' → 'geschätzt', 'f' → 'nicht mehr gegeben').",
            "Clarified and corrected ambiguous phrasing (e.g., 'in etliche Folianten' → 'in mehreren Folianten', 'per Subscriptiones' → 'per Subscription')."
        ],
        "3. Logical Clarity and Semantic Improvements": [
            "Separated payment terms into `<PAYMENT_SCHEDULE>` and `<ALTERNATIVE_TERM>` for clarity.",
            "Added `<TERM_TYPE>` and `<REDEEM_TERM>` to explicitly define payment schedules.",
            "Structured pricing and redemption terms more clearly with `<TOTAL_PRICE>` and `<NOTICE>`."
        ],
        "4. Metadata and Contextualization": [
            "Added `<SOURCE>` to encapsulate the original text for context.",
            "Included `<PUBLISHING_INFO>` to describe the publication's purpose and location."
        ]
    }
  }
}
